spans.s:
अ-गो, औस्, औस्, उ, Ved. destitute of cows.
—अगो-ता,
f. want of cows.

अगोचर अ-गोचर, अस्, आ, अम्, not obvious,
imperceptible by the senses; (अम्), n. anything that
is beyond the cognizance of the senses; Brahma;
the not being seen, absence.

अगोपा अ-गोपा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. without a
cowhered, not tended by one.

अगोरुध अ-गो-रुध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not
repulsing the cow; (Sāy.) not repelling or disdaining
praise.

अगोह्य अ-गोह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. uncon-
cealable, not to be covered, bright.
